description: This file defines the FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategyDao class, which handles database operations related to leave entitlement periods in the OrangeHRM leave management module. It includes logic for updating leave period start and end dates, notably when leave periods change or need to be adjusted based on user actions.

classes.name: FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategyDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing leave entitlement periods with FIFO strategy in OrangeHRM's leave module. Contains methods for handling leave period changes and updating leave entitlement date ranges.

methods.name: handleLeavePeriodChange
methods.description: Handles the logic for updating leave entitlement periods when the leave period changes, updating start and end dates accordingly within a transaction.
